findings.title: TOCTOU race can truncate a concurrently claimed file
findings.evidence: The existence check and the subsequent open in write mode are not atomic; two callers can both see the path as absent, then the second open truncates the file the first created.
findings.recommendation: Restore atomic exclusive creation with open(path, mode x) or os.open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL; do not use exists plus write mode.

findings.title: Dangling symlink bypasses existence check and redirects write
findings.evidence: os.path.exists follows symlinks and reports False for a dangling link; the following open in write mode then follows the link and creates or truncates the target outside the intended base path when an attacker can create links there.
findings.recommendation: Use exclusive creation that does not follow a final symlink, or reject symlinks with os.path.islink before opening, and keep the open itself atomic.

findings.title: Manual FileExistsError drops errno and filename attributes
findings.evidence: The previous open in exclusive mode raised FileExistsError with errno EEXIST and filename populated; constructing it with only the path leaves errno and filename as None, breaking callers that inspect those attributes.
findings.recommendation: Prefer letting the atomic open raise the exception, or raise FileExistsError(errno.EEXIST, os.strerror(errno.EEXIST), path).
